{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The '''''bes'marbure''''' (singular: '''''bes'marbur'''''), or spaulders, were pieces of [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] that protected the shoulders of the wearer. The ''bes'marbure'' was split between a right piece, the ''beskad bes'marbur'', and a left piece, the ''kal bes'marbur''. [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warriors typically reserved the ''beskad bes'marbur'' for clan or personal marks, while wearing unit insignia on the ''kal bes'marbur''. Later Mandalorian ''bes'marbure'' were much more reduced in size from the pauldrons worn by ancient Mandalorians like [[Mandalore the Indomitable]] during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]].<ref name="TBHC">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''</ref>
